content: yfinance const.py defines 11 sectorKeys (basic-materials, communication-services, consumer-cyclical, consumer-defensive, energy, financial-services, healthcare, industrials, real-estate, technology, utilities) and ~118 industryKeys spanning all sectors. Example industryKeys: software-infrastructure, semiconductors, biotechnology, banks-regional, oil-gas-e-p, aerospace-defense, specialty-retail, residential-construction, reit-industrial. Full mapping available in yfinance const.py on GitHub. Keys are hyphenated slugs derived from industry names.
